title: Dissolved silica colorimetric assay
author: Jian Gong
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bd7ni9me

steps.title: Add molybdate reagent and mix
steps.instruction: In 2 mL microcentrifuge tubes at room temperature, combine 1 mL of sample/standard/blank with 400 µL reagent A (molybdate solution), mix by pipetting up and down several times, and let stand for 10 minutes to form the silicomolybdate complex (solution turns yellow if silica is present).

substeps.instruction: Add 1 mL sample/standard/blank to a 2 mL tube.
Add 400 µL reagent A (molybdate solution) rapidly.
Pipette up/down several times to mix.
Let stand at room temperature for 00:10:00 (10 min).

steps.title: Add reducing reagent and incubate
steps.instruction: Add 600 µL reducing reagent rapidly to each tube, mix briefly with the pipet (total volume now 2 mL), observe the instant change from yellow to blue, and incubate the tubes in the dark for 3 hours before measurement.

substeps.instruction: Pipette up/down a few times to mix (final volume 2 mL).
Observe instant color change to blue (if silica present).
Incubate in the dark for 03:00:00 (3 h).

steps.title: Transfer to plate and read absorbance
steps.instruction: Load 200 µL of each incubated mixture into five replicate wells of a 96‑well plate and measure absorbance at 810 nm using the BioTek Synergy 2 multi‑mode plate reader.

substeps.instruction: Aliquot 200 µL of each reaction into five replicate wells of a 96‑well plate.
Measure absorbance at 810 nm with the BioTek Synergy 2 spectrophotometer.
